page.overview:
What is Bezan Black?

The Bezan Black is the primary ship of the Black Cat Pirates.

The Bezan Black is a simple red and black pirate ship with a black cat as a figurehead, and a pair of ornamental cat claws on the sides. Its hull has a green base. The front part of her keel, along with the figurehead, was torn off by Luffy during his battle against the Black Cat Pirates.

Kuro commanded the ship as captain of the Black Cat Pirates for years, up through his "final" battle against Morgan's Marine unit. During this time Nugire Yainu served as the ship's mechanic, until he was forced to act—and executed—as Kuro's decoy.

On succeeding Kuro, Jango assumed command and led the ship through several more years of successful plunder.
